title: Boiler Unit 2 waterside tube failure
description: Tube failure at rear tube sheet, unit flooded firebox. Failure surface shows oxygen pitting and thinning consistent with long-term corrosion. Unit isolated.
resolution_notes: Rental boiler placed and commissioned as SYS-0101. Repair vs replace decision with customer.

title: Commission rental boiler SYS-0101
description: Set up chemical feed, establish baseline chemistry, train operators.

title: CT-2 offline clean and disinfection (proposal)
description: Proposal to customer: offline clean, disinfection, and biocide program review for CT-2 following repeated elevated dipslide counts. Awaiting customer approval and Sego scheduling.

title: Sulfite depletion recurrence (ref WO-0142)
description: Recurring boiler alarms after WO-0142 was closed 7/8. Pump head was replaced but root cause was suction line air ingress. Customer escalated twice.
resolution_notes: Replaced suction tubing and foot valve, leak-tested, verified sustained feed.
